title: Accept the three-slice phone dashboard draft Plan
problem: The architecture choices are recorded in Decision 0077, but the replacement three-Action Plan needs operator acceptance. It must remain inactive until queue placement and activation are chosen separately.
desired_effect: Accept exactly the reviewed v2 proposal as an inactive Plan with Agent responsibility, preserve its receipt, and publish only its candidate branch for PR review.

does: Validate the exact candidate repository, clean branch and SHA-256 of the reviewed Ask input

Apply only settlement accept-phone-dashboard-plan-2026-09-29-v2 against preview 124b628b9f8e396e9e4365310ca7f82ed8f7dc601ae57639f439d647035108c5; Arcadia commits the inactive Plan on the candidate branch
Push only codex/runs-information-architecture, with no force, and write a timestamped log, canonical settlement receipt and failure handoff

Merge a PR, deploy, push main, reconcile Git, discard changes, expand credentials or grant spend

success.effect: The three-Action Plan is accepted but inactive, and its settlement is published on the candidate branch.

failure.effect: A stale or changed candidate/proposal refuses. A settlement that applied before a push failure retains its receipt; retry replays the same settlement key and retries only publication.
failure.next: Ask the agent to inspect run.log, failure-handoff.txt and settlement-receipt.json, preserve any applied record, refresh stale authority and retry only while accepting this exact inactive Plan remains intended.
